profile_text.body:
Cerence Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, trading under the ticker CRNC. Its website, which uses the name Cerence AI, describes the company as delivering conversational and agentic AI-powered user experiences for automotive and beyond, powered by its CaLLM family of language models. The site says Cerence provides tailor-made AI solutions that integrate with vehicles and is advancing generative AI and LLM-powered innovation for automotive and transportation.

The site highlights Cerence Emergency Vehicle Detection (EVD), an Audio AI product it says is already deployed in production vehicles. According to the site, EVD can detect and localize more than 1,500 emergency sirens across nearly 50 countries, identifying approaching emergency vehicles from more than 300 meters away with interior microphones and beyond 800 meters with exterior microphones. The site also describes work with Microsoft on Zero Trust and layered AI security for in-car assistants, including commentary by Kaivan Karimi and Frank Kaleck.

Public records list 191 Massachusetts law exposure entries associated with Cerence Inc. The company's SEC CIK is 0001768267. The site reports third quarter results with revenue up 12% year over year, connected services revenue up 20% year over year, and operating cash flow of $20M supporting a first-ever share repurchase program.
